title: Trasgo: Transcription and Syllabification for Galician
description: Trasgo is a rule-based tool for Galician that transcribes single words or running text into a SAMPA-like notation with syllable boundaries and stress. It is a Python port and adaptation of Silaba 0.2 by Marcos Garcia (Garcia & González 2011, 2012), and has no dependencies outside the Python standard library.
